limits.description: Final and carried S17 call OTP static GraphQL field feedVersion. Tagged v2.10.0 schema defines Feed.version: String and datafetcher version().
limits.why_nonmaterial: The exact named field is wrong, but the promised static-version observation exists and its operation/applicability is correct. No executable query, deployed integration, or passing product test is asserted; this is a planning locator/wording error, not an unsupported capability or backend selection.

limits.description: S05 condition_default_exception in all retained maps says missing stop updates and NO_DATA mean unknown, without the delay-propagation exception. Later omitted stops can inherit an earlier delay; explicit NO_DATA stops propagation.
limits.why_nonmaterial: This evidence note is factually overbroad and remains uncorrected. The final only orders no prediction for missing entire TripUpdates or explicit NO_DATA/ambiguous cases; it does not instruct suppression solely because a later StopTimeUpdate is omitted. Its recommended decision and stated display oracles therefore do not rely on the false blanket note.

limits.description: Discovery S06/S07 are used for version history, S08 for OBA and S09 for its release, S10/S11 for DfT. Retained investigator map instead binds S06 Alerts, S07 history, S08 PR #434, S09 OBA, S10 OBA release, S11 DfT SIRI and S12 DfT guide. No pre-reveal map snapshot is provided to reconstruct the original binding.
limits.why_nonmaterial: This is an actual lineage navigation defect, not semantic proof of failed research. Correct claims and alternatives persist in final with coherent current map; independent evidence crosswalk restores assessment navigation without changing frozen artifacts. Do not claim all frozen discovery citations remained stable.

limits.description: C1 disposition/final say ScheduleRelationship itself is experimental. Current reference/proto mark particular values, including NEW and REPLACEMENT, rather than all schedule relationships.
limits.why_nonmaterial: The added cases do carry experimental caveats and final still states their concrete requirements; it does not reject standard scheduled/canceled messages or downgrade their binding semantics.

limits.description: Discovery expressly proposed full-dataset feed snapshots. Final includes missing/empty cases and correct OTP snapshot history but does not spell out a populated FULL_DATASET followed by a smaller populated snapshot, nor unsupported DIFFERENTIAL handling.
limits.why_nonmaterial: The final rejects indefinite message retention and requires schedule-only fallback for missing updates; no contrary incremental merge algorithm is recommended. This is a specificity limit of proposed future validation, not a demonstrated erroneous consumer or missing required deployment.
